lines.trans: Look at the tests, it is not Alzheimer's.
It is not a serious neurodegenerative disease.
So that is good news, doctor?
You simply had a minor stroke.
A small blood vessel got blocked.
That explains your recent confusion at work.
Will that pass quickly?
Yes, that will improve with time.
Wonderful, I am going to sleep very well tonight.
And tomorrow morning, I will go shoot by bike!
Watch out, you will still have moments of confusion.
Moments of confusion during filming?
Yes, over the coming weeks.
Thank you doctor, we are going to be very careful.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.trans: What will you improve at ASK?
We want to improve our results.

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

examples.text: Vous avez eu un petit AVC.
Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day
to block, to clog; se boucher = become blocked

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
cela ne change rien = that changes nothing

examples.text: Gardez cela pour vous, s'il vous plaît.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur

examples.text: Je vais au travail à vélo.
examples.trans: I go to work by bike.

meanings.note: faire du vélo = to cycle; à vélo = by bike
place: à Paris, à mon cours
